outputs.name: chibi-wave
outputs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one transparent chibi school mascot illustration, part of a consistent six-image sticker/character-pose pack for a freshman guide.
Reference image 1 supplies ONLY recognizable character identity and costume language, not the pose or adult proportions. Transform into a charming polished CHIBI cartoon version: big head around 40 percent of total height, compact small body, expressive bright blue eyes, very long navy/indigo hair, red bridge-shaped hair ornament and small white birds, white/navy school uniform, blue tie and red accents, round bridge badge, wave-pattern blue cape, pleated skirt, white/navy sneakers. Keep this same chibi design consistently across the pack, original navy/light-blue/white/red palette. Clean hand-painted cartoon/anime sticker style, simplified readable costume details, soft shading, crisp silhouette, no white sticker border. Cute normal campus activities, modest uniform framing.
The new action MUST affect the legs, hips, torso, head and costume coherently. Hair/cape/pleats follow gravity and movement; do not copy the static original stance. Anatomically plausible simple hands. Full complete head-to-shoes figure, centered with transparent margins in portrait framing. Genuinely transparent alpha only; no backdrop, floor, scene, shadow, separate typography, speech bubble text, grid or poster. No extra characters.
Friendly welcome: leaning forward a little with cheerful smile, one hand waving near face, the other at her side, knees softly bent and one sneaker stepping outward. Cape folds and hair gently follow the leaning pose.
